title: MPW service: CodeWarrior Pro 4 MPW
note: The MPW disk for tools/mpw/mpw --toolchain cw: CodeWarrior Pro 4's MPW (the MPW Shell, Metrowerks' MWC68K/MWCPPC/MWLink68K/MWLinkPPC and Apple's Link, PPCLink, Rez...) and its Interfaces&Libraries, from the codewarrior-pro-4 snapshot (public media), on a volume named MPW laid out as the E.T.O. disk is; plus what Metrowerks' compilers link with, which the IDE install keeps outside the MPW folder: MSL C (headers and libraries) and MacOS Support's libraries, under Interfaces&Libraries; and ToolServer 3.4.1 (the toolserver-3.4.1 snapshot, from the same CD) in the MPW folder, as on the E.T.O. disk (tools/mpw/mpw names them: {MSLCommonIncludes}, {MSLMacIncludes}, {MSLLibraries}, {MWMacOS68K}, {MWRuntime68K}, {MWRuntimePPC}). Plus the Apple Shared Library Manager SDK (the aslm-sdk-2.0 snapshot, E.T.O. #22): whole under Interfaces&Libraries:ASLM 2.0, and merged where MPW looks: LibraryManager.h & co. in {CIncludes}, {PInterfaces}, {RIncludes}; the SC glue (LibraryManager.o, MPWLibs.cl.o...) in {Libraries}, the MrC glue in {PPCLibraries}; LibraryBuilder, BuildSharedLibrary and the other ASLM tools in MPW:Tools. Plus Universal Interfaces 3.3.2 (the mpw-gm snapshot: MPW-GM's Interfaces&Libraries, public media) beside the disk's own, as Interfaces&Libraries:Universal Interfaces 3.3.2, for code that needs Mac OS 9's interfaces (the HFS Plus calls: FSRef, FSCreateFileUnicode...); a build.mpw line "# interfaces: 3.3.2" (or mpw --interfaces 3.3.2) points {CIncludes}, {SharedLibraries} & co. there. MPW-GM's own tools are PowerPC-only and don't run in the 68k session.
